primary_outcome: Six paired combined-minus-waveform four-class macroF1 deltas separately on MIT development and INCART development. Timing-only diagnoses information sufficiency.
provisional_acceptance: Positive mean macroF1 and S F1 on each source; nondecreasing mean F recall and nonincreasing mean Brier on each source. Otherwise retain reference and report mixed effects. No statistical/clinical superiority or fresh confirmation.
